newsitem.title: NETHERLANDS: Hillary Clinton arrives at Dutch Schiphol airport.
newsitem.headline: Hillary Clinton arrives at Dutch Schiphol airport.

text.p: U.S. First Lady Hillary Rodham Clinton landed at Amsterdam's Schiphol airport on Tuesday for a day's programme of visits in the Dutch capital ahead of the arrival of President Bill Clinton later on Tuesday.
Clinton is due to fly to Schiphol from Paris on Tuesday evening in readiness for a bi-annual meeting on Wednesday with the European Union presidency, currently held by the Dutch.

Mrs Clinton was met by Rita Kok, wife of Dutch Prime Minister Wim Kok at Schiphol, before leaving for Amsterdam and an engagement at the University of Amsterdam where she is expected to give a speech on issues concerning, democracy, children's welfare and women.
Her programme includes a boat cruise through Amsterdam followed by a visit to the Rijksmuseum, the Netherlands' national museum and art gallery.

Rodham Clinton rounds off her Amsterdam programme with a visit to the canalside home of Anne Frank, the young Jewish girl whose diaries tell how she hid from Nazi occupiers during World War Two before her capture and imprisonment in Auschwitz.

The First Lady then departs for the Hague to meet the President who will arrive by helicopter from Schiphol ahead of his EU programme on Wednesday, which is combined with a commemoration of the 50th anniversary of the postwar Marshall aid.
